alt: YouTube URLs in input/sample.txt are fetched with yt-dlp and transcribed by AssemblyAI with speaker labels; one LLM pass maps (Speaker A) to Lex Fridman and a second extracts the statement "Scaling laws suggest that larger models will continue to improve." with its speaker and the person it mentions; SurrealDB links person, session and statement nodes through person_session, person_statement, session_statement and statement_mentions edges, entity resolution collapses "GPT-4", "GPT4" and "OpenAI's GPT-4" into one tech node, and a SurrealQL query lists each statement with its speaker; adding a URL processes only that episode.

run.cmd: docker run -d --name surrealdb --user root -p 8787:8000 -v surrealdb-data:/data surrealdb/surrealdb:latest start --user root --pass root surrealkv:/data/database

run.note: Build the graph from the URLs in input/sample.txt
Browse it in Surrealist: ws://localhost:8787, namespace cocoindex, database yt_conversations
